system.flavor:
Catch the pickpocket at your shoulder, spot a figure ducking behind a market stall, see the cat moving in a dark alley, or know which face in a crowd is watching you.

Not enough to see through walls or find someone who has truly gone to ground.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Detect the location of one concealed but not fully hidden enemy within 3 units; gain +1 Fortitude against that enemy until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: An adjacent willing ally gains the same defensive bonus.

rider.title: Adaptation - Chimera
rider.html: Assume Lateral Eyes (upkeep 0): ordinary visual concealment within 1 unit does not impose penalties on your attacks; solid barriers and complete invisibility still matter.
